brief: An 8-second recipe checklist: four numbered steps ('Boil water', 'Add pasta', 'Stir 8 min', 'Drain and serve') appear one at a time, each with a checkbox that ticks itself just after the step appears; a progress bar across the top advances by a quarter with each tick and ends full.
checks: The video shows exactly four numbered steps in this order: 1️⃣ Boil water, 2️⃣ Add pasta, 3️⃣ Stir 8 min, 4️⃣ Drain and serve.
Each step’s text is large (≈ 1/10 of the frame height or larger) and has high contrast against its background.
No text or checkbox touches or crosses any edge of the frame; there is a clear margin around all on‑screen elements.
Every step appears with its own checkbox positioned consistently (e.g., left of the text) and the checkbox is visible when the step text first appears.
Within the first 0.5 seconds of the video at least one visual element (step text, checkbox, or progress bar) is already visible – there is no empty opening.
The progress bar starts empty and advances by exactly one‑quarter of its length each time a checkbox ticks, reaching full after the fourth tick.
Each quarter‑advance of the progress bar eases in and out (slow start and slow end) rather than moving at a constant speed.
After the final checkbox ticks and the progress bar is full, the final composition remains static for at least 0.5 seconds before the video ends.
Throughout the video there are no glitches, flicker, overlapping text, or visible rendering artifacts.
The colors used for text, checkboxes, and the progress bar form a harmonious palette with no clashing or overly saturated hues.
The picture fills the entire frame; there are no black bars, borders, masks, or hard‑edged vignettes.
All on‑screen elements are aligned to a clear layout (e.g., left‑aligned text with checkboxes, progress bar centered at the top) and are evenly spaced vertically.
In every one‑second interval of the video there is a visible change (appearance of a step, a checkbox tick, or progress‑bar movement) – no dead air.
All animations (step appearance, checkbox tick, progress‑bar movement) ease in and out instead of moving at a constant speed.
